mod.name: TB Revive Player
mod.summary: Gives dead players a second chance. They can be revived by a medic with a defibrillator, respawn at a hospital, or respawn at a house they own. Each way has its own wait time, price and health penalty, and premium players get their own settings files.
mod.notes: The *Premium files have the same settings as the normal ones and apply to premium players. Remove "Defibrillator" from cfgIgnoreList.xml in the mission folder or defibrillators vanish at restart.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

defibrillatorHealthLoss.label: Defibrillator health loss
defibrillatorHealthLoss.help: Health the defibrillator loses per use, in percent. Higher means it wears out faster. The generated file has 0.

defibrillatorCanBeRepaired.label: Defibrillator repairable
defibrillatorCanBeRepaired.help: Whether a worn defibrillator can be repaired.

minTimeBeforeKillButton.label: Respawn button delay
minTimeBeforeKillButton.help: Time before a downed player can press the respawn (kill) button instead of waiting for help.

minTimeBeforeKillWhenNoOtherPlayerIsOnli.label: Respawn button delay when alone
minTimeBeforeKillWhenNoOtherPlayerIsOnli.help: Delay used when no other player is online.

minTimeBeforePremiumKillWhenNoOtherPlaye.label: Respawn button delay when alone (premium)
minTimeBeforePremiumKillWhenNoOtherPlaye.help: Delay for premium players when no one else is online.

files.title: Hospital revive
files.summary: Respawn at a hospital after dying.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

enable.label: Enabled
enable.help: Turns the hospital revive way on or off.

minTimeBefore.label: Wait before revive
minTimeBefore.help: Minimum time a downed player must wait before this revive is offered.

minTimeBeforeWhenNoOtherPlayerIsOnline.label: Wait when alone
minTimeBeforeWhenNoOtherPlayerIsOnline.help: Same wait, used when no other player is online.

enabledInPVPZones.label: Works in PvP zones
enabledInPVPZones.help: Allows this revive inside PvP zones. Works with the PVEZ and Ninjins PvP-PvE mods.

damageConfig.maxWounds.label: Max wounds after revive
damageConfig.maxWounds.help: Most wounds (injuries) the revived player can get.

damageConfig.minWounds.label: Min wounds after revive
damageConfig.minWounds.help: Fewest wounds the revived player gets.

damageConfig.health.label: Health after revive
damageConfig.health.help: Health the player has after the revive, from 0 to 1 (1 is full).

damageConfig.blood.label: Blood after revive
damageConfig.blood.help: Blood level after the revive, from 0 to 1 (1 is full).

damageConfig.shock.label: Shock after revive
damageConfig.shock.help: Shock after the revive, from 0 to 1. 0 means maximum shock, 1 means none.

blacklistAreas.label: Blocked areas
blacklistAreas.help: Circles on the map where this revive does not work.

saveItemInHand.label: Keep item in hand
saveItemInHand.help: Remembers the item the player held when dying.

putItemInHand.label: Return item to hand
putItemInHand.help: Puts the remembered item back in the hand. Needs Keep item in hand to be on.

canSelectRespawnLocation.label: Player picks the spot
canSelectRespawnLocation.help: Lets the player choose where to respawn.

enableSlotSave.label: Keep only listed slots
enableSlotSave.help: When on, only the slots in the list below are kept; the rest is lost on death.
enableSlotSave.risk: Players lose everything outside the listed slots.

slotsToSave[].slotName.label: Slot name
slotsToSave[].slotName.help: DayZ slot name such as Headgear, Body or Vest.

slotsToSave[].saveCargo.label: Keep contents
slotsToSave[].saveCargo.help: Also keep what is inside the item in that slot.

slotsToSave.label: Slots to keep
slotsToSave.help: Inventory slots whose items are kept.

spawnPoints[].id.label: Id
spawnPoints[].id.help: Unique id of the spawn point; leave as it is.

spawnPoints[].orientation[].label: Angle
spawnPoints[].orientation[].help: One value of the facing vector.

spawnPoints[].orientation.label: Facing
spawnPoints[].orientation.help: Direction the player faces after respawning.

spawnPoints[].point[].label: Coordinate
spawnPoints[].point[].help: One of X, Y, Z (in that order).

spawnPoints[].point.label: Position
spawnPoints[].point.help: Respawn position as X, Y, Z.

spawnPoints[].name.label: Name
spawnPoints[].name.help: Name players see when choosing. The generated name is just the coordinates; rename it to something readable.

spawnPoints[].price.label: Price
spawnPoints[].price.help: Cost to use this hospital. -1 means free.

spawnPoints.label: Hospitals
spawnPoints.help: Places where players respawn after dying.

currencyType.label: Currency (old)
currencyType.help: Marked deprecated in the file. The price is set per hospital above.

price.label: Price (old)
price.help: Old global price, no longer used for hospitals. Set prices on each hospital.

damageConfig.label: Condition after revive
damageConfig.help: Health, blood, shock and wounds of the player right after being revived.

blacklistAreas[].position.label: Centre
blacklistAreas[].position.help: Centre as X, Y, Z map coordinates.

blacklistAreas[].position[].label: Coordinate
blacklistAreas[].position[].help: One of X, Y, Z (in that order).

files.title: Logging
files.summary: Logging of revives to CSV and Discord.

version.label: Config version
version.help: Managed by the mod itself. Leave it as it is.

isInitialized.label: Initialised flag
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod once the file was created. Leave it as it is.

logSteamIdInLog.label: Steam id in Discord log
logSteamIdInLog.help: Include the Steam id in the Discord revive message.

logRevive.label: Log revives
logRevive.help: Write each revive to the CSV log.

discordReviveWebhookURL.label: Discord address: revives
discordReviveWebhookURL.help: Webhook address for revive messages. Needed when Discord logging is on.
discordReviveWebhookURL.risk: The address works like a password for the channel: anyone who has it can post there. Do not share it.
